data.name: HotReloadOf
data.value: {program}: {said}
data.comment: What Hot Reload came to for one program of several applied at once (a run's services, the Debug window's programs), after its name.

data.name: RunsServices
data.value: the run's services
data.comment: Names a container or Aspire run's services together, as what Hot Reload applied to (HotReloadOf's program).

data.name: HotReloadSaid
data.value: Hot Reload: {said}
data.comment: What Hot Reload came to, as a program's console and the status bar say it.

data.name: RestartedToApply
data.value: Restarted in {took} to apply changes: {said}
data.comment: A program restarted to apply edits Hot Reload could not apply as it ran: how long the restart took, and what Hot Reload said of the edits.

data.name: DebuggingStopped
data.value: Debugging {name} was stopped as it started
data.comment: Debug of a program that Stop ended as it started.

data.name: AttachingStopped
data.value: Attaching to {name} was stopped
data.comment: Attach to a program that Stop ended before the debugger had it.

data.name: CannotLetGo
data.value: {name} cannot be let go: Hot Reload changed its code, after which its runtime lets no debugger go; restart it to run it without the debugger
data.comment: Detach, or a tab's close, of a program Hot Reload changed, whose runtime would hold it for good once let go.

data.name: FolderClosed
data.value: Could not debug {name}: its folder was closed
data.comment: A debugger's start that came after its folder was closed.

data.name: EndedDuringLaunch
data.value: The workspace ended during launch
data.comment: A debugger's start whose folder ended as it started.

data.name: EndedBeforeLaunch
data.value: Debugging {name} ended before launch completed
data.comment: A debugger's start whose session or tab ended before its launch completed.

data.name: StoppedAsAttached
data.value: Debugging {name} was stopped as the debugger attached, and it runs on
data.comment: An attach that Stop ended as the debugger attached, the program running on.

data.name: CouldNotDebug
data.value: Could not debug {name}: {why}
data.comment: A debugger's start that failed, and why (the debug adapter's reason, or the system's).

data.name: StarterUnstarted
data.value: {starter} could not start
data.comment: Debug of a program another starts (func, Windows) where that starter could not start.

data.name: StarterEnded
data.value: {starter} ended before it started {name}
data.comment: Debug of a program another starts (func, Windows) where that starter ended before starting it.

data.name: StarterEnds
data.value: {why}; {starter} and all it started end, as {name} would wait for the debugger
data.comment: Debug of a program another starts that failed ({why}): the starter is ended, as what it started would wait for good.

data.name: NotRestartedToApply
data.value: Could not restart to apply changes: {why}
data.comment: Hot Reload's restart of a debugged program, to apply edits it could not apply as it ran, that could not start it again, and why.

data.name: AttachedTo
data.value: Attached to {program}
data.comment: What Attach to Process came to once the debugger has the program, as an agent's ide_action answers.

data.name: NotRunWithHotReload
data.value: {program} is not run with Hot Reload
data.comment: Debug of a program through its Hot Reload session where it runs with none.

data.name: HotReloadFolderClosed
data.value: Could not attach to {name} for Hot Reload: its folder was closed
data.comment: Hot Reload's quiet attach to a program that came after its folder was closed.

data.name: HotReloadUnattached
data.value: Could not attach to {name} for Hot Reload: {why}
data.comment: Hot Reload's quiet attach to a program that failed, and why (the debug adapter's reason, or the system's).

data.name: DebuggerStartedIt
data.value: The debugger started this program: Stop ends it, and Detach lets go only of a program attached to
data.comment: Detach of a program the debugger started, which Detach never lets go.

data.name: StarterStartedIt
data.value: Passenger started this program through the one that starts it, which ends with it: Stop ends both, and Detach lets go only of a program attached to as it ran
data.comment: Detach of a program Passenger started through another (func, Windows), which ends with it.
